issues.legal_issue: A court in the area where a woman was sent as a consequence of continuing marital cruelty has territorial jurisdiction to try the alleged offences, even when the cruelty also occurred in another area.
material_facts: The complaint alleged that the woman was subjected to continuing cruelty and harassment by her husband and his relatives at the matrimonial home, including over dowry demands.
The complaint alleged that her husband brought her to her parental home and left her there because the demands had not been met, threatening consequences if she returned without meeting them.
She remained at the parental home and lodged the criminal complaint there.
issues.conclusion: The continuing nature of the alleged offence and the consequence in the area where the complaint was filed gave the court there territorial jurisdiction. The High Court's orders quashing the proceedings for lack of jurisdiction were set aside, and the trial court was permitted to proceed without any view being expressed on the merits.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 177 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, an offence is ordinarily tried where it was committed. Sections 178(c) and 179 allow inquiry or trial in an area where a continuing offence continues to be committed, or where a consequence of the act ensues. Applying these provisions, the Court relied on Sujata Mukherjee v. Prashant Kumar Mukherjee and State of M.P. v. Suresh Kaushal, and distinguished Y. Abraham Ajith v. Inspector of Police and Bhura Ram v. State of Rajasthan on the facts.

predicates.criminal_case_alleging_continuing_marita: The proceeding is a criminal case alleging continuing cruelty or harassment by a spouse or the spouse's relatives.
predicates.cruelty_continued_across_local_areas: The alleged cruelty or harassment occurred over time in more than one local area.
predicates.victim_sent_to_forum_area_as_consequence: The alleged perpetrators sent or left the victim in the area where the complaint was filed as a consequence of the alleged continuing cruelty or harassment.
predicates.forum_court_has_territorial_jurisdiction: The court in the area where the complaint was filed has territorial jurisdiction to proceed.

issues.definition: If a criminal case alleges continuing marital cruelty across local areas and the victim is sent to the forum area as a consequence, the forum court has territorial jurisdiction.
